title: Ali Ali moula Moula Ali Ali
body:
Ali ali, ali ali, ali ali, ali ali..(2)
aye dushman o wo khum ke manzar ko yaad rakhna
khandak ko yaad rakhna, khaibar ko yaad rakhna
zehra ka darr jalaya, us darr ko yaad rakhna
<<DIVIDER>>
nauke sina pe jo tha, us sarr ko yaad rakhna
har matami hai kehta, lena hai aaj badla
mushkil kusha hamara, bolega ye zamana
ali ali maula maula ali ali maula..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
ali maula, ali maula, ali maula...(4)
ali ali maula maula ali ali maula..(2)
1. Jo dushmane ali hai maut apni wo marenge
ghar ko jalane wale ab umr bhar jalenge
<<DIVIDER>>
ye daeshi yazidi hargiz na bach sakenge
rehbar se darne wale Mehdi se kya ladenge
ek aisi jung hogi maujega ye zamana
ali ali maula maula ali ali maula..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Hai intezare Mehdi taqwe se aur khirad se
imdaad mil rahi hai allah-us-samad se
Mehdi ki jang hogi haide hi ki rasad se
duniya ko fatha karna hai ya ali madad se
<<DIVIDER>>
khaiber kusha hamara, mushkil kusha hamara
ali ali maula maula ali ali maula..(2)
3. Farzande fataima hai ye warise nabi hai
Abid hai ye hai Baqir ye hai Raza Taqi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Jafar hai ye hai Kazim, ye Askari Naqi hai
Hasnain e waqt ye hai, ye waqt ka Ali hai
ghaibat mein aaj bhi hai zinda ali ka beta
ali ali maula maula ali ali maula..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Farshe azaa ke bache hai mimbaro ke paale
rozo ke ye mujahid qur'aan ke hawale
ye mujtahid, ye alim ummat ko hai sambhale
ye matami mujahid ye hai namaz wale
<<DIVIDER>>
kirdaar baat-ta hai maula ali ka shia
ali ali maula maula ali ali maula..(2)
5. Ye kaun tha ke jisne Zehra pe darr giraya
siddiqa e jaha'n ko darbaar mein bulaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Zehra ne zakhm khake kuch bhi nahi bataya aur tooti pasliyo ko maula se bhi chupaya
aye zulfiqar e haider le inteqam e Zehra
ali ali maula maula ali ali maula..(2)
6. Maula ali ye dekhe karbobala ka manzar
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir gir chuke hai teero ki sar zamee' par
teero tabar bohot hai inse zyaada patthar
sukha gala hai kat-ta hai qund kitna khanjar
karle qubool maula in rehmato ka pursa
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ali maula maula ali ali maula..(2)
7. Chadar nahi hai sar par ye shaam ka safar hai
bhai bhi hamsafar hai nauke sina pe sar hai
hai darmiya'n mein zainab majma idhar udhar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
aao madad ko baba ab saatwa(7) ye darr hai
zainab ne har qadam ko hai aapko pukara
ali ali maula maula ali ali maula..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Ye jang aakhri hai himmat ali se lenge
Mehdi pe jaan denge jannat ali se lenge
Zehra se hum shahadat izzat ali se lenge
ye nasiran e Mehdi taqat ali se lenge
ye hai qamar ka nauha, safdar ka hai ye naara
<<MINI>>
